svg.title: Ze component architecture
svg.desc: A registry-driven Ze daemon with compact component boxes and clear connector gutters. Operator surfaces use one shared command and configuration contract. The Plugin Server provides the typed EventBus and command dispatcher. BGP includes RPKI origin validation and ASPA path verification. External five-stage plugins are controlled over authenticated TLS. Config-selected routing and subscriber components feed route selection and the FIB. An internal Dataplane group contains Netfilter, VPP, ARP, ND, and DHCP; Netfilter and VPP connect to their external Linux and VPP targets.

g.text: One runtime. Shared contracts. Pluggable systems.
Compact components leave dedicated gutters for every relationship
NORTHBOUND SURFACES · SHARED COMMAND AND CONFIG CONTRACT
PLUGIN EXECUTION · CONTROLLED BY THE PLUGIN SERVER
SHARED MESSAGE BUS · PLUGIN SERVER EVENTBUS · TYPED MESSAGES + SUBSCRIPTIONS
